function.name: financial-data/financial-data/getStockQuotes
function.description: Essential tool for Real-Time Price Monitoring. Retrieve current market prices, absolute and percentage price changes for multiple US and international securities simultaneously. Use this for live trading analysis and portfolio tracking. Timezone: EST. Supports batching up to 300 identifiers per request.

format.description: Output format. JSON is standard for real-time AI dashboards.

identifiers.description: Comma-separated list of trading symbols (e.g., MSFT,AAPL). Use this to get bulk updates for a watchlist in a single call.

function.name: financial-data/financial-data/getLatestPrices
function.description: Premium real-time monitoring tool. Provides granular 1-minute OHLCV data for the current trading week across 10,000+ securities (US, International, and ETFs). Ideal for tracking immediate price action, identifying intraday support/resistance, and analyzing volume spikes in the last few days. Timezone: UTC. Limit: 300 records.

format.description: The output format. JSON is optimized for real-time AI pattern recognition.

offset.description: Pagination marker for walking back through time. To retrieve the next 300 minutes of historical data for the current week, increment this value by 300 (e.g., 0, 300, 600) until the target time range is reached.

identifier.description: The unique trading symbol (e.g., MSFT or AAPL).
